business_definition: Unique loan application identifier (APP followed by 6 digits)
Applicant who submitted the application (foreign key to applicant.csv). One applicant can have more than one application
Applicant annual income in U.S. dollars as stated on the application. Stored as text with a dollar sign and commas
Months with the current employer on the application date
FICO score of the latest credit pull with a returned score on or before the application date. Empty for applicants with no credit history
Two-letter state the application was submitted from (NC, FL, TX or CA). It does not change if the applicant later moves
Loan amount or credit limit requested in U.S. dollars. Stored as text with a dollar sign and commas
Loan product requested (foreign key to loan_product.csv)
Payment debt-to-income ratio in percent, tested against loan_product.max_dti_pct. Not the same measure as applicant_risk_features.debt_burden_ratio
Applicant is an active-duty servicemember eligible for SCRA protections
Applicant has a bankruptcy in the last seven years
Applicant has collection activity in the past 12 months
Intake decision from the product gates and the applicant-tier overlay: Approved, Review or Declined
Date the application was submitted (M/D/YYYY)
Final underwriting outcome: Approved, Declined or Withdrawn. Empty while the application is open
Date of the final decision (M/D/YYYY). Empty while the application is open
Unique product identifier used across loan applications
Human-readable product name
Product line: Mortgage, Credit Card or Auto Loan
Short description of the product's qualifying conditions
Worst applicant risk tier accepted (T1 is best, T5 is worst). Tested against applicant_risk_features.risk_tier, not a FICO band
Minimum FICO score required
Product accepts an applicant with no credit score through manual underwriting
Base annual percentage rate for the product
Maximum loan amount or credit limit. Stored as quoted text with commas
Maximum payment debt-to-income ratio in percent
Applicants with a bankruptcy in the last seven years may qualify
Applicants with collections in the past 12 months may qualify
Rate adjustment in percentage points by applicant risk tier, for example T1=-2.00;T2=-1.00
Rate adjustment in percentage points when collection activity is present
Rate adjustment in percentage points when bankruptcy history is present
Maximum interest rate for applicants with SCRA protections
Unique credit pull event identifier
Application the credit pull belongs to (foreign key to loan_application.csv)
Date of the credit pull (YYYY-MM-DD)
FICO score returned by the pull. Empty when the pull returned no result (Error or Pending)
Credit bureau: Experian, Equifax or TransUnion
Pull status: Completed, Resubmitted, Error or Pending
Reason for the pull, for example Initial Application or Credit Refresh
Surrogate identifier of the risk-feature row (unique)
Application the risk profile belongs to. One row per application (primary key and foreign key to loan_application.csv)
Date the pre-decision risk profile was evaluated; equals the application date (YYYY-MM-DD)
Credit history available at the as-of date: ESTABLISHED, LIMITED_HISTORY or NO_HISTORY
Months of credit history observed within the 24-month lookback
Maximum days any account was overdue in the lookback
Count of delinquency events in the lookback
Total outstanding debt balance at the as-of date
Total overdue amount at the as-of date
Total outstanding debt divided by annual income (a stock-to-flow ratio that can exceed 1). Not the payment DTI
Total overdue amount divided by annual income
Risk points for delinquency severity (0 to 5)
Risk points for debt burden (0 to 3)
Risk points for overdue amount (0 to 3)
Sum of the three points fields (0 to 11). Empty for applicants with no credit history
Applicant risk tier T1 (very low risk) to T5 (very high risk) under policy RISK-TIER
How the tier was assigned: CREDIT_HISTORY, LIMITED_HISTORY or NO_CREDIT_HISTORY
Version of the RISK-TIER ruleset used
Unique synthetic applicant identifier (APL followed by 6 digits)
Applicant first name (synthetic)
Applicant middle name (synthetic)
Applicant last name (synthetic)
Applicant date of birth (M/D/YYYY)
Current street address (synthetic)
Unit or apartment
City of the current address
Two-letter state of the current address (NC, FL, TX or CA). An applicant who moves must submit a new application
Five-digit ZIP code
Country code (US)
Synthetic phone number in the reserved 555-01xx range
Synthetic name-based email address
Email, Phone or Mail
Married, Unmarried or Separated. ECOA prohibited basis: never used in risk or eligibility decisions
US Citizen, Permanent Resident or Noncitizen. Not a risk factor under RISK-TIER
Applicant occupation
